decks.notes: This Aggro Red Deck Wins deck focuses on dealing quick and efficient damage to the opponent through direct damage spells and creatures with haste. The key strategy is to play powerful one and two-drop creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner and Monastery Swiftspear, while also utilizing burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Light Up the Stage to maintain card advantage and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to provide additional removal options. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive gameplay centered around sacrificing creatures for value. Utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to control the board while dealing incremental damage to the opponent. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing key creatures from opponents, while Thoughtseize helps disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes a strong mana base with dual lands and utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant. With consistent threats and disruptive elements, this deck looks to quickly close out games against opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively sacrifice creatures, utilizing cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also focuses on disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base includes a mix of lands that support the deck's strategy and allow for flexibility in playing the various cards. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive sacrifices and efficient removal spells.

This deck focuses on using evasive spirits to quickly apply pressure to the opponent while disrupting their plans with counterspells and removal. The key strategy is to use powerful spirit synergies such as Supreme Phantom and Spell Queller to take control of the board and protect our creatures, while also drawing cards with Curious Obsession to maintain our momentum. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements like Shacklegeist and Lofty Denial, this deck aims to outpace the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with efficient removal spells and powerful creatures. By combining a mix of disruption like Thoughtseize and removal like Fatal Push with strong threats such as Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, the deck aims to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. The inclusion of card advantage engines like Castle Locthwain and Bloodtithe Harvester helps maintain the deck's momentum and ensure that it can keep up the pressure on the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control of the board and tempo through low-cost and efficient spirits while utilizing card draw and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early with aggressive creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom, while protecting them with cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller. Curious Obsession provides additional card advantage, while Lofty Denial and Shacklegeist offer disruption and protection. The inclusion of Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional utility and options in certain matchups.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, utilizing Collected Company to bring out creatures like Catacomb Sifter and Mayhem Devil for aggressive plays. The deck also includes sacrifice synergy with cards like Priest of Forgotten Gods and Woe Strider, as well as card advantage with cards like Gilded Goose and Prosperous Innkeeper. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast mana ramp, creature aggression, and sacrifice interactions to secure victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Retraction Helix to generate powerful synergies. The deck includes a combination of planeswalkers, such as Wrenn and Realmbreaker, Karn, the Great Creator, and Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast, along with various creatures and mana accelerators. The key strategy is to use Retraction Helix to bounce artifacts and creatures, triggering powerful abilities and generating advantageous board states. The deck also includes cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to further enhance the combo potential and synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering spells, disrupting the opponent's board with removal, and generating card advantage through powerful draw effects. It aims to stabilize the board with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and generate card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also uses Shark Typhoon as a win condition and has a solid mana base to support its control strategy. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can win with its powerful threats.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which involves playing Parhelion II and Greasefang, Okiba Boss together to create a powerful synergy. The deck also includes cards like Grisly Salvage, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil for card selection and disruption, along with other support cards like Esika's Chariot and Witherbloom Command. The deck aims to control the board with removal and disruption, while also setting up the combo for a strong finish.

The main strategy of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while efficiently removing threats with cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Waste Not provides value when opponents discard cards, and Liliana of the Veil can further disrupt their hand. The win condition comes from powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Tergrid, God of Fright. The deck also includes some lands that can provide additional utility, like Geier Reach Sanitarium for card selection.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through green devotion cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, then utilize powerful green aggro creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide card advantage and further ramp opportunities. The deck also includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect against opposing threats. Ultimately, the strategy revolves around fast mana acceleration and aggressive creature plays to dominate the battlefield.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures such as Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant while supporting them with cards like Embercleave and The Akroan War for added aggression. The deck also includes versatile cards like Esika's Chariot and Voldaren Thrillseeker for various board states. With efficient mana ramp from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as strong finishers like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spirit creatures to apply pressure early on while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and tempo plays. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional mana source and provides flexibility in mana fixing. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault backed up by tricky interactions.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays that involve sacrificing creatures for value. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to generate damage and disrupt the opponent's board state. The deck also includes Claim the Firstborn to steal the opponent's creatures and sacrifice them for additional benefits. The main win condition is to chip away at the opponent's life total while generating incremental advantage through sacrifice effects and removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck's companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana flexibility and serves as a backup plan for late-game aggression.

The focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck includes various ways to draw cards and discard cards to help fuel the graveyard, along with creatures like Thing in the Ice to help control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures, utilizing the synergy between spells and creatures to create a powerful aggro strategy.
